# Wordfire
> Peer-to-peer campfire storytelling. One word at a time.

- Live: https://wordfire.jonbailey.xyz/
- Source: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/wordfire
- License: MIT

## One-liner
Friends add one word (or an optional short phrase) to a shared story. Local pass-and-play on one device, or a remote circle over WebRTC data channels.

Version: 2.1.1

## Modes
- Pass-and-play on one device (offline-capable PWA)
- Remote circle via room code, link, or QR; the story travels peer-to-peer
- Optional TURN relay when a direct path cannot form and the host has configured one
- Optional AI friends on local circles
- Local archive of finished stories on this device

## Privacy
Guest-first. No accounts. Finished stories stay in this browser unless you export or share them.

Remote rooms use this site only to introduce peers (roster + WebRTC handshake). Story text then goes peer-to-peer. Peers may learn each other's IP addresses during ICE. An optional relay, when configured, carries the same encrypted data-channel traffic if a direct path fails.

Optional AI friends on a local circle send the story so far to this app (`/api/spark`) so they can take a turn. If a live model is not configured, a local word bank answers.

No analytics or advertising pixels.
